Join.title: Cosa Nostra
Join.subtitle: A game of whispers, lies, and survival. One phone each. Twelve seats at the table.
Join.name: Your name
Join.hint: Mock mode — no account, no server. Everything lives on this phone.

Lobby.title: Waiting for the table
Lobby.subtitle: The game starts when everyone is seated.
Lobby.hint: In the real game the host starts the round.

Role.title: Your role
Role.hint: Your role is secret. Reveal it only when nobody is looking.
Role.confirmHint: Hold the eye button in the top bar any time to check your card.
Role.crewHint: Only the Mafia can see this.

godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.short: Leads the Mafia and orders the kill.
godfather.ability: Each night, choose one player for the Mafia to eliminate.
godfather.win: Mafia wins when no Town members remain, or nothing can stop them.
godfather.tip: Stay hidden behind your crew. Order kills that make the Town suspect each other, and never be the loudest voice.

framer.name: Framer
framer.ability: Each night, frame one player. Investigations show them as Mafia.
framer.win: Mafia wins when no Town members remain, or nothing can stop them.
framer.tip: Frame players who are likely to be investigated. A failed frame is worse than no frame.

detective.name: Detective
detective.short: Finds the Mafia, one clue at a time.
detective.ability: Each night, investigate one player and learn their faction.
detective.win: Town wins when every Mafia member is eliminated.
detective.tip: Reveal results carefully. Once the Mafia know you are the Detective, you are the next target.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.ability: Each night, protect one player from death.
doctor.win: Town wins when every Mafia member is eliminated.
doctor.tip: Protect the players who are shaping the discussion, not only yourself.

villager.name: Villager
villager.short: No powers. Only your voice and your vote.
villager.ability: No night action. Find the Mafia through discussion and voting.
villager.win: Town wins when every Mafia member is eliminated.
villager.tip: Your only power is pressure. Track contradictions and force people to commit to reads.

jester.name: Jester
jester.short: Wants to be voted out — and win alone.
jester.ability: No night action. If the table votes you out, you win immediately.
jester.win: Get eliminated by a day vote.
jester.tip: Act suspicious, but not so obviously that the table dismisses you as a joke.

Action.title: Action
Action.nightIntro: The table is asleep. Choose carefully — nobody will see this.
Action.dayIntro: Use your ability before the vote. Everyone may notice.
Action.noActionBody: Your role has no ability at this time. Stay quiet and watch.
Action.passiveBody: You have no active ability. Your power is your voice and your vote.

sentences.framer: Frame {first}, then {second}, so investigations show them as Mafia

Action.dragHint: Drag a player into a blank. Drag between blanks to reorder.

NightReport.title: What happened tonight
NightReport.subtitle: Only you can see this report.
NightReport.startingIn: Starting day in {seconds, plural, =1 {1 second} other {# seconds}}
NightReport.quiet: A quiet night. Nothing happened to you.

Day.title: Discuss
Day.subtitle: Accuse, defend, whisper. When the table is ready, call the vote.

Vote.title: Cast your vote
Vote.subtitle: Choose who to eliminate. The table is watching.
Vote.hint: The player with the most votes leaves the table.
Vote.tie: The vote was tied. Nobody leaves the table.

GameOver.title: Game over
GameOver.subtitle: The table is revealed. Every secret is out.
GameOver.mockNote: Mock end screen. A real game would continue until a faction wins.

Whispers.title: Whispers
Whispers.subtitle: Private words. Choose them carefully.
Whispers.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No whispers left today} =1 {1 whisper left today} other {# whispers left today}}
Whispers.empty: No whispers yet. Start one with a player at the table.
Whispers.newHint: Pick a player. Only the two of you will see it.
Whispers.limitReached: You have used all whispers for today.
Whispers.deadCannotSend: Dead players cannot whisper. Use the Graveyard.
Whispers.recipientDead: This player is dead and cannot receive whispers.

seed.sofia1: Did you see how quiet Marco went after the vote?
seed.lucia1: If I'm gone tomorrow, look at Sofia.
seed.lucia2: Deal. I'll keep my vote ready.
seed.enzo1: Doctor here. I can't protect you every night.

Codex.title: Codex
Codex.subtitle: Roles, factions, and the rules of the table.

mafia.title: Mafia
mafia.body: The hidden killers. Each night they choose a victim, and each day they blend into the table.

town.title: Town
town.body: The uninformed majority. They have the numbers, but must find the Mafia before it is too late.

neutral.title: Neutral
neutral.body: Nobody's ally. Neutrals play for their own win condition, not for Mafia or Town.

secret.title: Your role is secret
secret.body: Hold the eye button to peek at your card. Let go and it hides again.

night.title: Night
night.body: Players with night abilities act in private. The table waits for dawn.

day.title: Day
day.body: Discuss openly. Whispers are private. When discussion ends, the table votes.

vote.title: Vote
vote.body: The player with the most votes is eliminated and their role is revealed.

whisper.title: Whispers
whisper.body: You can send a limited number of private one-to-one messages each day.

report.title: Night report
report.body: After every night you receive a private report of what happened to you and the table.

win.title: Winning
win.body: The game ends when a faction completes its win condition.

action.def: An ability used during the night or day.

faction.def: The side you win with: Mafia, Town, or Neutral.

frame.def: Make an innocent player appear as Mafia to investigations.

majority.def: More than half of the living players.

roleblock.def: Prevent a player's ability from working that phase.

whisper.def: A private message between two players.

seed.killedBody: Lucia (Villager) was killed by the Mafia.
seed.blockedBody: Your night action failed. Someone blocked you.
seed.investigatedBody: Your order reached the crew before dawn.
seed.nightBody: The table went quiet and night actions started.
seed.voteBody: Lucia was eliminated. She was the Villager.

Admin.title: Host controls
Admin.subtitle: Manage the flow of the table.
Admin.skipHint: Skips the current timer or step and moves the table forward.
Admin.unavailable: No next step from this phase.
Admin.mockNote: Host-only controls. In the real game these actions belong to the host.
Admin.killMeHint: Test the dead state and the Graveyard.

Graveyard.title: Graveyard
Graveyard.subtitle: Only the dead can see this room.
Graveyard.lockedBody: Only dead players can enter the Graveyard.

seed.lucia1: So this is the other side. Quiet, but at least nobody is voting.
seed.lucia2: They bought the frame. Watch Sofia — she is steering the table.

Spectator.title: You are dead
Spectator.subtitle: You can watch the table, but you can no longer act or vote.
